title: Sextortion or intimate-image threat
summary: Someone threatens exposure and demands money, images, or continued contact.
scenario: The threat is used to create panic and isolate you from support.
warning_signs: Demand for payment or additional images
Instructions to keep the situation secret
safe_actions: Do not pay or send more material
Stop engaging where safe and preserve evidence
Tell a trusted person and prioritize immediate safety
recovery_guidance: Secure accounts and review privacy settings
Contact the relevant platform through its known safety route
Seek local support if there is immediate danger or coercion
reporting_guidance: Keep threats, account identifiers, and timestamps
Use a verified reporting destination and avoid forwarding intimate material
prevention_tips: Limit who can contact or view your accounts
Do not let a threat isolate you
false_positive_notes: A threat can be false or exaggerated, but preserve evidence and seek support without paying.
